summary: Skyworks Solutions filed an 8-K announcing proposed mergers with Qorvo, referencing an effective S-4 registration statement and joint proxy statement/prospectus. Skyworks will issue common stock to Qorvo stockholders in a stock-for-stock transaction. The filing provides no per-share price, premium, or deal value, nor board recommendation or advisors. The S-4 was declared effective December 23, 2025, and the definitive proxy/prospectus was mailed same date. Structural note: all-stock merger with Skyworks as issuer/acquirer. Watch for stockholder vote results and merger completion timeline; risk-arb centers on exchange ratio and regulatory clearances.
